LESSON: READING 12.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 12.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: what will happen in the story, with peers. 1) How can we tell where events have taken place in a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
